title: September Closeout and October Opening Ledger
operating_status: Open — future calendar and owner outcomes held
summary: A cutoff-aware, append-only ledger that reconciles every September calendar, owner, longitudinal, and publication control while preserving immutable release snapshots.
publication_boundaries: This control plane preserves the immutable Phase 156, 164, and 172 snapshots and projects live state only from append-only dated receipts.
A future calendar item remains future, an owner item remains Held, and an unsuccessful source search never establishes nonexistence.
The September 23 DARPA companion recheck retains the original Cycle 001 identity and adds zero cycle gates.
No future result, owner disposition, repository publication, hosted deployment, public launch, or v1 promotion is inferred.

cutoff_projection_contract.terminal_rule: A record is terminal only when an allowed decision status, decision date, and receipt identity are all present and the decision date is not later than the projection cutoff.
cutoff_projection_contract.due_rule: An unresolved calendar record is Due on its scheduled date, not silently overdue.
cutoff_projection_contract.overdue_rule: An unresolved calendar record is Overdue only after its scheduled date passes.
cutoff_projection_contract.owner_rule: Owner and publication controls remain Held without a calendar-overdue inference.
cutoff_projection_contract.append_only_rule: Later source checks append receipt events and projections; they do not rewrite Phase 156, 164, or 172 or delete prior terminal events.
